SELECT pb.pb_id pbId, pb.factor_type factorType, dict.item_value factorTypeStr, pb.prd_portfolio_id prdPortfolioId, (CASE WHEN pb.factor_type ='0' THEN fin.finprod_name ELSE ptl.portfolio_name END) prdPortfolioName, pb.update_time updateTime, DATE_FORMAT(pb.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH:mm:ss') updateTimeStr, sysuser.real_name updateUser, pb.seqno FROM TRD_PB_RELATION pb LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio ptl ON pb.prd_portfolio_id=ptl.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON pb.prd_portfolio_id=fin.FINPROD_ID AND fin.finprod_type2 = 'F16' LEFT JOIN sys_datadict_list dict ON dict.dict_code ='FACTOR_TYPE' AND pb.factor_type =dict.item_code Left join sys_user sysuser on sysuser.user_name=pb.update_user
ORDER BY pb.update_time
